behaviour: Sanitize arrowheadSize on restored line and arrow elements (retaining valid non-default values in [0.5, 1.5] and deleting invalid or default values) and validate currentItemArrowheadSize in restoreAppState.
rules: 1. Import `DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE` and `isValidArrowheadSize` from `@excalidraw/element`.

2. In `restoreElementWithProperties`, omit `"arrowheadSize"` from `Required<...>` in `T` (adding optional `arrowheadSize?: ExcalidrawLinearElement["arrowheadSize"];`) and from `Required<T>` in `K` (`keyof Omit<Required<T>, keyof ExcalidrawElement | "arrowheadSize">`) so `arrowheadSize` remains optional on linear elements.

3. In `restoreElement` (`case "line":` / `case "draw":` and `case "arrow":`), before calling `restoreElementWithProperties`, if `!isValidArrowheadSize(element.arrowheadSize) || element.arrowheadSize === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE`, execute `delete element.arrowheadSize;` so invalid, out-of-range, `undefined`, or default (`1`) `arrowheadSize` keys are stripped and never added to elements that omit it.

4. In `restoreAppState`, set `currentItemArrowheadSize: isValidArrowheadSize(nextAppState.currentItemArrowheadSize) ? nextAppState.currentItemArrowheadSize : DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE,` in the returned object.

Strip `element.arrowheadSize` via `delete element.arrowheadSize` when `!isValidArrowheadSize(element.arrowheadSize) || element.arrowheadSize === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE`.

behaviour: Export ArrowheadSizeSmallIcon, ArrowheadSizeMediumIcon, and ArrowheadSizeLargeIcon for the arrowhead size RadioSelection control.
rules: 1. Export `ArrowheadSizeSmallIcon`, `ArrowheadSizeMediumIcon`, and `ArrowheadSizeLargeIcon` using `createIcon(..., modifiedTablerIconProps)` depicting a horizontal arrow shaft with small, medium, and large arrowheads.

behaviour: Add changeArrowheadSize to the ActionName union.
rules: 1. Add `| "changeArrowheadSize"` to `ActionName` right after `| "changeArrowhead"`.

behaviour: Register actionChangeArrowheadSize with Small/Medium/Large RadioSelection and render it in actionChangeArrowProperties.
rules: 1. Import `ARROWHEAD_SIZES` and `DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE` from `@excalidraw/element`, `ArrowheadSize` from `@excalidraw/element/types`, `Mutable` from `@excalidraw/common/utility-types`, and `ArrowheadSizeSmallIcon`, `ArrowheadSizeMediumIcon`, `ArrowheadSizeLargeIcon` from `../components/icons`.
2. Export `actionChangeArrowheadSize = register<ArrowheadSize>({ name: "changeArrowheadSize", label: "labels.arrowheadSize", trackEvent: false, ... })`.

3. In `perform`: assert `invariant(value, "actionChangeArrowheadSize: value must be defined")`. Update selected linear elements (`isLinearElement(el)`): when `value === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE`, call `newElementWith(el, {}, el.arrowheadSize !== undefined)` and `delete (element as Mutable<ExcalidrawLinearElement>).arrowheadSize` so the own property `"arrowheadSize"` is removed while bumping `version`/`versionNonce` if previously set; otherwise call `newElementWith(el, { arrowheadSize: value })`. If `isElbowArrow(element)`, recompute its route with `newElementWith(element, updateElbowArrowRoute(element, app.scene.getNonDeletedElementsMap()))`. Update `appState: { ...appState, currentItemArrowheadSize: value }` with `captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY`.

4. In `PanelComponent`: render a `<fieldset>` with `<legend>{t("labels.arrowheadSize")}</legend>` and a `<div className="buttonList">` containing `<RadioSelection<ArrowheadSize>>` (`group="arrowhead-size"`) with options Small (`ARROWHEAD_SIZES.small`, `t("labels.small")`, `ArrowheadSizeSmallIcon`, `testId: "arrowheadSize-small"`), Medium (`ARROWHEAD_SIZES.medium`, `t("labels.medium")`, `ArrowheadSizeMediumIcon`, `testId: "arrowheadSize-medium"`), and Large (`ARROWHEAD_SIZES.large`, `t("labels.large")`, `ArrowheadSizeLargeIcon`, `testId: "arrowheadSize-large"`), using `getFormValue` to read `element.arrowheadSize ?? DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE` for linear elements where `canHaveArrowheads(element.type)` or `appState.currentItemArrowheadSize` when nothing is selected.
5. In `actionChangeArrowProperties`, render `{renderAction("changeArrowheadSize")}` immediately after `{renderAction("changeArrowhead")}`.

behaviour: Copy and paste arrowheadSize between arrows in actionPasteStyles, clearing arrowheadSize when pasting from a default-sized arrow.
rules: 1. Import `type { Mutable } from "@excalidraw/common/utility-types"`.

2. In `actionPasteStyles`, when `newElement.type === "arrow" && isArrowElement(elementStylesToCopyFrom)`, copy `elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize` when defined, or clear `arrowheadSize` when `elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize === undefined` (passing `force = shouldClearArrowheadSize` to `newElementWith` and deleting `newElement.arrowheadSize` so the own key is removed), before `if (isElbowArrow(newElement))` recomputes the elbow route.
